turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Owen's essay. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?
Be honest. On a scale of one to ten, how am I doing in this meeting?
I'm not grading you. Why was a zero entered before anyone called me?
And what's one thing I could do better?
That's not my job. Who made the call to enter that zero, and was Owen spoken to first?
